description: Subcolumns are typed as ClickHouse keeps them (size0 and sizeN of arrays, keys, values and size0 of maps, the null mask of Nullable values and of arrays of them, and the fields of a Nested column as arrays), and higher-order array functions take their lambda's parameters from the arrays they are called with, so arrayMap returns an array of what its lambda returns and arrayFold its accumulator's type.
